people.name: Adrian Martineau, PhD
people.role: Clinical trialist — Vitamin D and Respiratory Infections
people.key_contribution: Lead author of 2017 BMJ meta-analysis (25 RCTs, n=11,321) on Vitamin D and ARTI prevention; Martineau IPD meta-analysis is current gold standard for Vit D-immunity research
notable_works: Martineau AR et al. BMJ 2017 — Vitamin D supplementation to prevent ARTI

people.name: Harri Hemilä, PhD
people.role: Epidemiologist — Vitamin C and Common Cold
people.key_contribution: Cochrane systematic reviews of Vitamin C for common cold; corrected Linus Pauling's overclaims; showed benefit in physically stressed populations; honest, nuanced analysis of C evidence
notable_works: Hemila H & Chalker E Cochrane 2013 — Vitamin C for preventing and treating common cold

people.name: Ananda Prasad, PhD
people.key_contribution: Pioneer of zinc deficiency research; zinc lozenges meta-analysis showing 33% cold duration reduction; discovered role of zinc in thymulin and T-cell function; established zinc as essential immune micronutrient
notable_works: Prasad AS J Nutr Biochem 2008 — Zinc lozenges and common cold

people.name: Philip Calder, PhD
people.key_contribution: World-leading researcher in nutritional immunology; Omega-3 and immune function meta-analyses; SPM research; EFSA expert on immune claims; authored key Nutrients reviews
notable_works: Calder PC Nutrients 2013 — Omega-3 Fatty Acids and Inflammatory Processes
Multiple Omega-3 immunity RCTs and reviews

people.name: John White Zamvil, PhD / Pui Tan Liu, PhD
people.key_contribution: 2006 Science paper identifying Vitamin D receptor activation as inducer of cathelicidin (LL-37) in macrophages; mechanistic basis for Vitamin D-innate immunity link; tuberculosis application
notable_works: Liu PT et al. Science 2006 — Vitamin D-mediated induction of innate immunity in gingival epithelial cells

people.name: Mihai Netea, PhD
people.key_contribution: Pioneer of 'trained immunity' concept: innate immune cells can develop memory-like responses via epigenetic reprogramming; beta-glucan and BCG vaccine as trained immunity inducers; fundamental rethinking of innate immunity
notable_works: Netea MG et al. Science 2016 — Trained immunity
Netea MG et al. Nature Reviews Immunology 2020

people.name: Janice Kiecolt-Glaser, PhD
people.key_contribution: 30+ years of research on stress and immunity; wound healing and stress; vaccine response and stress; marital conflict and immunity; foundational psychoneuroimmunology research
notable_works: Kiecolt-Glaser JK Ann Rev Psychol 2020 — Psychoneuroimmunology and Stress
Multiple PNAS/JAMA papers on stress and immune function

molecules.name: Cathelicidin LL-37
molecules.role_in_domain: Vitamin D-induced innate defense against bacteria (M.tb), viruses (influenza, SARS-CoV-2); disrupts pathogen membranes; key mechanism explaining Vit D immunity effects

molecules.name: Secretory IgA (sIgA)
molecules.role_in_domain: First-line mucosal defense in gut, respiratory, urogenital tracts; neutralizes pathogens without inflammation; produced in GALT; enhanced by probiotics

molecules.name: Resolvin D1 / E1 (SPMs)
molecules.role_in_domain: Derived from EPA+DHA; actively resolve inflammation; switch macrophage M1→M2; stop neutrophil infiltration; restore tissue homeostasis post-infection

molecules.name: IL-6 (Interleukin-6)
molecules.role_in_domain: Acute infection: beneficial B-cell stimulator; chronic elevation (from visceral fat, stress): drives systemic inflammation, immunosuppression, and metabolic syndrome; key biomarker for immune dysregulation

molecules.name: Beta-glucan (1,3/1,6)
molecules.role_in_domain: Dectin-1 receptor ligand in macrophages; trains innate immunity via epigenetic reprogramming; URTI reduction in RCTs; oat source also reduces LDL cholesterol

molecules.name: Glutathione (GSH)
molecules.role_in_domain: Primary antioxidant in immune cells; protects neutrophils/macrophages from oxidative burst self-damage; synthesized from NAC; declines with age and stress

molecules.name: Thymulin
molecules.role_in_domain: Produced in thymus; requires zinc as cofactor; promotes T-cell differentiation and maturation; zinc deficiency → thymulin inactive → impaired T-cell immunity; explains zinc-T-cell connection

molecules.name: NK Cells (Natural Killer Cells)
molecules.role_in_domain: Kill infected cells (viral) and tumor cells without prior sensitization; cytotoxicity reduced 28% by sleep deprivation; reduced by chronic stress; enhanced by regular exercise

organizations.name: Cochrane Collaboration
organizations.role: Producer of gold-standard systematic reviews: Hemila Vitamin C, Hao Probiotics, Karsch-Völk Echinacea, Martineau Vitamin D — primary evidence source for immunity claims

organizations.name: Radboud Center for Infectious Diseases (RCI)
organizations.role: Netea lab: trained immunity research; beta-glucan and BCG for innate immune training; cutting-edge innate immunology

organizations.name: EFSA (European Food Safety Authority)
organizations.role: Issues authorized health claims for food/supplement immunity benefits; most rigorous standard for immune claim validation; basis for 'ช่วยสนับสนุนระบบภูมิคุ้มกันที่ปกติ' claims

organizations.name: World Health Organization (WHO) Nutrition Division
organizations.role: Global guidance on micronutrient deficiency and immunity; Vitamin A supplementation programs; Zinc and childhood mortality; Selenium status maps

case_studies.title: Martineau 2017 BMJ — Vitamin D and ARTI Meta-Analysis
case_studies.description: Individual participant data (IPD) meta-analysis; 25 RCTs; n=11,321; primary outcome: ARTI; overall: 12% risk reduction; severe deficiency (<10 ng/mL): 70% risk reduction; daily/weekly dosing superior to bolus; no adverse effects at 2000-4000 IU/day; current gold standard for Vit D immunity claims

case_studies.title: Cohen 2009 Arch Intern Med — Sleep and Cold Susceptibility
case_studies.description: Prospective cohort of 153 volunteers; tracked sleep habits 2 weeks; exposed to rhinovirus nasal drops; controlled quarantine 5 days; <6h sleep → 4.2x infection risk; <7h sleep → 2.9x; most rigorous human sleep-immunity experiment; dose-response confirmed

case_studies.title: De Flora 1997 Eur Respir J — NAC and Influenza in Elderly
case_studies.description: Double-blind RCT; n=262 elderly; NAC 600mg BID vs placebo for 6 months during flu season; all participants vaccinated; NAC group: 25% symptomatic influenza; placebo: 79%; significant reduction despite vaccination; key evidence for NAC in high-risk immune support
